help.title: Help Center
help.hero_desc: Browse FAQs or submit a support request below.
help.faq_1_a: You can go to 'Upgrade' in the account menu, choose a suitable plan and pay via MoMo, ZaloPay or bank card.
help.faq_2_q: Can I download music for offline listening?
help.faq_2_a: Yes. This feature is exclusive to Premium accounts. Just click the Download icon next to the song or playlist.
help.faq_3_a: Please check your network connection. You can also try reducing Audio Quality in Settings > Audio Quality.
help.faq_4_a: Go to Avatar > Account > Security to change your password.
